name: Reynard
source:
Fayline Arcana, a private detective, has to interview a very peculiar man to see if he's fit for the job she has lined up.

Will he get the job?

[From [url=https://prikarin.itch.io/reynard]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
私家侦探费琳·阿卡纳必须采访一个非常奇怪的男人，看看他是否适合她安排的工作。

他会得到这份工作吗？

[来自[url=https://prikarin.itch.io/reynard]itch.io[/url]]
